SSC CPO SI 2024 Final Marks

Post Date: July 24, 2026

12:40 pm

Staff Selection Commission (SSC), has released Revised Final Result With Marks on official website for the recruitment of Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Paper-II Examination Post. This recruitment is for 4187 positions. The SSC Paper-II Exam was Conducted in 08 March 2025. The last date to submit the application form was 28 March 2024. Candidates Can Also Check All Details on Official SarkariExam2026 and can be checked through Enrollment number / Registration number / Date of birth by login into the portal. Which has given below.
